fit_reason: Whole car (2006 Mercedes E500 sedan) listed by a private owner in the cars-by-owner section.
findings: Dull, flat-looking gray paint on the hood and driver-side doors with little reflection
Dust and grime along the lower rocker panels and rear bumper
Brake dust buildup on the wheels
Dirty, dusty driver floor mat and door sill area
Dusty center console and dash area; leather seats look dry and dull
Cloudy, slightly yellowed headlight lenses in the front shot
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the E500 4MATIC. The gray paint looks a bit flat in the photos, and the driver floor area and sills could use a cleanup. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a buff and headlight restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
